map.：30°C、相对湿度 70%：Stull 近似湿球≈25.6°C；湿度越低湿球越: : 30°C, RH 70%: Stull approx wet-bulb ≈25.6°C; lower humidity gives lower wet-bulb (stronger evaporation), and at saturation wet-bulb = air temp.
map.：湿球 35°C 是人体散热极限（无法靠出汗降温），虽罕见但极端湿热下致命，湿球: : Wet-bulb 35°C is the human heat-dissipation limit (sweating can't cool), rare but lethal in extreme humidity-heat; above 28°C is high-risk work.
map.湿球和体感一样吗？: Is wet-bulb the same as perceived temperature?
map.不同。湿球是「蒸发到极限的温度」，是物理量；体感是综合感受，WBGT 才含湿球作: No. Wet-bulb is the 'temperature at evaporation limit', a physical quantity; perceived temp is a combined feeling, and WBGT uses wet-bulb as a heat-stress metric.
